# License allowlist

Every dependency and bundled asset must carry one of these licenses. CI fails on anything
else. All identifiers are OSI-approved SPDX licenses. Exceptions are individual, dated, and
listed in `licenses/curations.yml`.

| Scope | Applies to | Allowed licenses |
|---|---|---|
| `ship` | Linked into published artifacts (npm packages, Android artifacts, the Swift package). | 0BSD, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, ISC, MIT, Zlib |
| `dev` | Build, test, and CI tooling that is never shipped. Includes everything in "ship". | 0BSD, Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, EPL-2.0, ISC, MIT, MPL-2.0, Python-2.0, Zlib |
| `fonts` | Font files, wherever they are committed. | OFL-1.1 |
